svg.title: Figure 02 | From multiscale observations to biological state trajectories
svg.desc: Panel A shows schematic transcriptomic profiles, distinct cell types, liver tissue organization and injury-associated changes, and relative serum ALT activity. Joint observations constrain an inferred biological state. Panel B shows reference-associated and disease-associated regions within one illustrative three-dimensional state-space projection. A black path shows observed states s0 and s1. Three conditional predictions extend from s1: a gray untreated continuation and two differently colored intervention trajectories. Values, state regions and trajectories are illustrative; surface height and shading do not represent measured energy or probability.

g.text: From multiscale observations to biological state trajectories
Conceptual illustration. Readouts, state regions and trajectories are schematic; surface elevation has no physical units.
